requirement_understanding: The SAPPL Product Master Data module allows enterprise users to manage SAPPL Product entities within the Ambica application. Users can create new SAPPL product names, view/search existing records in a paginated data table, update existing product entries, and delete product records with confirmation or cancellation options.
requirement_gaps: Maximum allowed character length for SAPPL Product Name is not explicitly specified in the interface UI.
Handling of duplicate product name creation is underspecified (whether exact match or case-insensitive validation occurs).
Soft-delete vs hard-delete retention rule for dependent master records is not clear.
business_rules: SAPPL Product Name must be mandatory upon submission.
Product Name must be unique across active records.
Deleting a product requires explicit user confirmation via dialog action.
Search filter dynamically filters records by SAPPL Product Name substring.
assumptions: User is pre-authenticated with administrative or master-data editing privileges.
The target backend web services are active on the centralindia azure cloud domain.
Deleting a record immediately removes or archives the item from the data table.
risks: Cascade deletion risk if foreign keys reference SAPPL product names in transactions.
Lack of client-side length constraints might lead to unexpected database truncation errors (HTTP 500).
Missing rate limits on duplicate checks could allow automated enumeration.
modules_impacted: SAPPL Product Master Grid / Data Table

test_strategy.objectives: Validate full CRUD workflow end-to-end, enforce strict boundary and field-level isolation validation, ensure UI resilience, and verify security/API compliance.
test_strategy.scope_in: Add SAPPL Product Name, View details, Edit Product Name, Delete with confirmation/cancel, Search filtering, Modal dismissals.
test_strategy.scope_out: Authentication flow, User Role Provisioning, Non-SAPPL master modules.
test_strategy.rollback_plan: Execute database seed cleanup scripts post-test run to purge temporary entities created with prefix 'AUTOTEST_'.

api_validation: Verify POST /api/sappl-product returns 201 Created on valid creation.
Verify PUT /api/sappl-product/{id} returns 200 OK on valid update.
Verify DELETE /api/sappl-product/{id} returns 200/204 status on successful deletion.
Verify API returns 400 Bad Request on empty or oversized payload.

Verify flag update (if soft delete) or record removal upon delete.
security_validation: Verify CSRF token submission on create, update, and delete API calls.
Verify non-authorized user cannot trigger deletion API endpoints directly.
Validate input sanitization against DOM XSS and SQL Injection payloads.
performance_validation: Ensure product list loads within < 1.5s for 1000+ records.
Verify search filter debounces inputs (300ms) to eliminate redundant API requests.
Submit modal operations should complete within < 800ms API response time.
accessibility_validation: Confirm modal dialog traps keyboard focus when active.

release_readiness: READY WITH CAVEATS - Dynamic table IDs (`pn_id_8-table`) should be replaced with stable attributes before automated test execution in production pipelines.
coverage_summary: 100% coverage across core CRUD workflows, validation limits, search features, security vectors, and boundary conditions.
ai_self_review: Covered full CRUD operations, field-by-field input isolation, security payloads, boundary limits, and no programmatic string multipliers were used.

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

def run(playwright):
    browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=False)
    context = browser.new_context()
    page = context.new_page()
    page.goto("https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login")
    page.click("button:has-text(\"Master Data\")")
    page.click("a:has-text(\"SAPPL Product\")")
    page.click("button:has-text(\"Add Product Name\")")
    page.fill("#sapplProductName", "AUTOTEST_PROD_101")
    page.click("button:has-text(\"Submit\")")
    page.fill("input[placeholder=\"Search by SAPPL Product Name\"]", "AUTOTEST_PROD_101")
    browser.close()
